title: Was great, not dumbed down
body: This used to be one of the best self-development apps out there. But then they made some changes that make it almost useless: 1. They now limit the size of text to 100 characters. That means if you were using it in a serious way, with more complete self-development notes for yourself, this is now impossible. 2. Instead of the interesting themes they used to have, they now have ads for movies, integrated right into the app, even for paying users. So you’re now paying them to shove ads for movies in your face (on top of that, they are usually bad movies with horrible reviews). They’ve fallen low.

title: Amazing app
body: Dear Apple user, if you land on this review and are pondering getting Finch. Do not ponder no more and RUN to download it ! This is the cutest and best self care app I’ve tried (and i tried many). It’s easy to use, it’s fun, it’s cute. It has helped me feel better about myself, it has helped me create a routine, it helps me not forget things, it helps me with self care, home care, health care. And also if I skyp a goal or forget something I don’t feel bad because Finch is a gentle app and not a guilt trip app. I have a chronic illness and Finch has been helping on though days. I really really love this app and it’s concept and community. I’m so excited to see what the developers and the team will come up with in the future monthly events or just generally 💜. I wish I had more friends who spoke English so I could suggest Finch to them 😮‍💨

title: this app helped me so much
body: Sometimes I struggle with daily tasks, as I suffer from anxiety and depression. Usually these kinds of apps don’t help me at all, as I just tend to get over my initial spurt of motivation pretty quickly. But this one is different. I’ve been on this app for multiple months now with a 70 something day streak. I can’t tell you exactly what the difference is between this app and other apps I’ve tried but it has done wonders for me. Not only am I more productive, I can also appreciate the little things I achieve on a daily basis now. Which helps me have empathy for myself and thus motivate me to go on every day. I’m currently using the free version of the app and you definitely don’t need more to get started. I can’t only recommend!

title: Adorable and very helpful
body:
Finch is amazing, it is well-thought-out and executed. My little finch buddy, Odysseus makes me smile a lot. 
The app keeps my attention, which most mental health apps don’t because it always looks like work and is way too serious. 
Finch is playful, it doesn’t suck out any more of your energy, instead it gives you an interesting and multi-faceted way to deal with your struggles. 

I have severe social anxiety which makes it very hard to even leave the house so it was a very big step to reach the ‘go outside once’ goal daily. 

To the Finch Team; 
You are doing a fantastic job!! 
I appreciate you!
